title: 1. Express skips a stop
front: You are on an uptown A train at 42 St–Port Authority. Choose where you want to go, then ask the station attendant for help. Tell the attendant about your situation.
routes: get off at 59 St–Columbus Circle, take the uptown C (or B on weekdays) local, get off at 81 St
stay on this A express train and get off at 125 St
start: 42 St–Port Authority, on an uptown A train
problem: the A train runs express from 59 St to 125 St and skips every stop in between
ann: “This is an uptown A express train to Inwood–207 Street. The next stop is 59 Street–Columbus Circle. After 59 Street, the next stop is 125 Street.”
items: Said the destination and their situation

title: 2. Station skipped (classroom scenario)
front: You are on an uptown C train at 59 St–Columbus Circle. Choose where you want to go. Listen to the announcement, then ask the attendant for help.
routes: uptown C trains skip 72 St; ride to 81 St, cross to the downtown C, and go back one stop to 72 St (or walk south from 81 St)
not affected; stay on the C and get off at 81 St
condition: You don't want to walk much.
start: 59 St–Columbus Circle, on an uptown C train
problem: (classroom scenario) due to station work, uptown C trains skip 72 St; downtown trains still stop there
ann: “Attention passengers: due to station work, uptown C trains will not stop at 72 Street.”
items: Said the destination and their situation
e.g. "You don't want to walk much."

title: 5. McDonald's drive-thru

Choose something for yourself from the menu.

front: You are at a busy McDonald's in Times Square. Order a meal and a dessert at the counter.
